item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a 2024 source showing Srettha explicitly demanding personal loyalty, replacing neutral bureaucrats wholesale, or building a named cult-of-personality apparatus. I also did not find a clean example of him strengthening neutral state institutions against partisan use. The evidence is therefore indirect: absence of cult-like rhetoric on one side, but persistent politicization and repression in the system on the other.","evidence":[{"title":"Thailand pledges to uphold democracy and human rights at Summit for Democracy","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-03-20","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/summit-for-democracy-statement-2024?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c3060006848","summary":"Srettha publicly aligned his government with democracy, rule of law, and human rights.
